content.short: DeployTokens is a no-code tool for creating and deploying tokens on major blockchains in minutes.
content.description: DeployTokens lets anyone create a token without writing code: choose the settings, connect a wallet and deploy an auto-verified contract. Its site includes a guide for creating a token on Unichain, and Blockscout's Unichain app marketplace lists it.
content.meta: DeployTokens is a no-code token creator with auto-verified contracts, supporting Unichain.
